confirmed_findings.detail: The Statement uses mathematical notation as plain prose in lines 34 and 40. Line 34 starts “Let f∈C²(R^d)” and continues with S_εf(x)=∫… and x∈R^d without inline-math delimiters; line 40 similarly has “C² function f” and ε>0. In the original-resolution preview those expressions render on the prose baseline as literal text, unlike the properly delimited estimate at line 36. Add math delimiters to the notation in those lines. This is a source formatting defect; no mathematical claim was changed.

The TikZ L-shaped domain has a near-white filled region in the dark local preview; the Γ_D and corner labels placed on/near that fill become faint and hard to read. The standalone original tile and an original-resolution local crop confirm the low contrast. The sector geometry and boundary-edge placement match the stated L-domain and 0<θ<3π/2 convention; no overlap with adjacent prose was seen. Consider a darker muted fill or dark label color while keeping the blue Γ_D boundary visually distinct.

editorial_candidates.detail: An optional reference-to-physical simplex schematic could label F_K(xhat)=A_K xhat+b_K, the vector push-forward J_K^{-1}A_K vhat, and the oriented surface-vector transformation n ds=J_K A_K^{-T} nhat d shat. It could show that these two transformations preserve the oriented facet flux, with arrows and orientation indicated. This would make the geometric relation among lines 33, 35, and 37 easier to follow; it is an editorial clarity candidate, not a missing prerequisite or mathematical defect.

Four unit squares alternate permeability 10^6 and 1, and each square is split along one diagonal; labels are centered per square and apply to both constituent triangles as the caption says.
The reference right triangle has vertices (0,0), (1,0), (0,1); outward normals are correctly shown as (0,-1), (-1,0), and (1,1)/sqrt(2) on the bottom, left, and hypotenuse.

The refinement drawing has eight leaf triangles after three generations and places original-edge midpoints M,N,P and interior median midpoint S consistently with the text and the listed leaf vertex triples.
